consequence.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds a new capability to support Azure workload identity for Git and OCI repository authentication; existing configurations are unaffected.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds support for Azure workload identity as an authentication method for Git and OCI repositories.
